cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One extra chair in the hall won't trouble you, will it? Put it at the head of the table for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's fine. I'll move it over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll sit there for the tenants' meeting tonight. Leave the other chairs around it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to move a chair, not host your meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit beside me and explain that distinction when we begin. I'll put use of the hall first, since you've raised it.

heightening.evidence: A5 increases B4 furniture-only boundary into an obligation to explain it publicly at the meeting.
